characters.doreen.talk.hmRecipePeatConfi: Hm? The recipe for Peat? Confidential.
characters.doreen.talk.hungryHaveSomeDav: Hungry? Have some Davre ramen. Just add water. Water? Of course you buy that from us too.

characters.doreen.chapter.iMDavreFoodS: I'm Davre Food's supply rep for the Lower Levels. Davre Food—cheap and filling.
characters.doreen.chapter.usingHydraTech: Using a HydraTech purifier, I see. Don't throw it away when it wears out—I'll buy it back.
characters.doreen.chapter.pressesBusines: presses a business card onto the counter
characters.doreen.chapter.weReBuyingHydr: We're buying HydraTech purifiers in bulk. New or used.
characters.doreen.chapter.rDWantsTakeThe: R&D wants to take them apart.
characters.doreen.chapter.thisLeviathanD: This is the Leviathan. A Davre product.
characters.doreen.chapter.mightNotFilter: It might not filter quite as well as a HydraTech, but it handles Rustwater and Ghostwater.
characters.doreen.chapter.lastsLongerTha: And it lasts longer than a HydraTech.
characters.doreen.chapter.onePerWeekJust: One per week. Just call to order.
characters.doreen.chapter.howMuchWaterTh: How much water there is doesn't really matter. What matters is who controls the purification process.
characters.doreen.canningDeal.pastelLook: Pastel is looking to move into food, so HQ has decided to secure the market first.
characters.doreen.canningDeal.theyVeAppr: They've approved a batch of equipment specifically for small shops like yours.
characters.doreen.canningDeal.oneGrinder: One grinder, one canner. Pay the {0}₵ handling fee and they're yours. You'll have to find your own raw materials.
characters.doreen.canningDeal.ifMachineB: If a machine breaks or you need another one, just call.
characters.doreen.canningDeal.slotsWonTW: The slots won't wait. Call when you've made up your mind. The fee stays the same.
characters.doreen.daily.leviathanWornOut: Leviathan worn out? Don't worry, it's mass-produced.
characters.isa.bye.rememberThisVisitDoes: Remember, this visit does not constitute medical advice. (in an official tone)
characters.isa.talk.upUpperLevelsZeroChe: Up in the Upper Levels, ZeroChew goes by a different name: “Slim-X”. Same drug, but the price would buy you a whole box of ZeroChew.
characters.isa.talk.immunivaxOneShotEver: Immunivax, one shot every week. Such a steady stream of repeat customers. (sarcastically)
characters.isa.talk.firstThreeDigitsSeri: The first three digits of the serial number identify the batch. The recalled batches are listed in the manual. Remember to check against it.
characters.isa.talk.oxymorePerfectlyLega: Oxymore is perfectly legal, you know. All the paperwork is in order.
characters.isa.talk.someSaySentinelColla: Some say Sentinel Collapse was engineered. The company has no comment. (in an official tone)
characters.isa.talk.carmichealHoldsPaten: Carmicheal holds the patent for Phagimycin, yet most people have absolutely no idea.
characters.isa.chapter.isaLangdonMarketC: Isa Langdon, Market Compliance Officer, Carmicheal Pharmaceutical.
characters.isa.chapter.weMakeMostMedicin: We make most of the medicine you'll come across. Immunivax in particular—a masterpiece of pharmaceutical chemistry.
characters.isa.chapter.butRecentFloodCop: But the recent flood of copies has been cutting into genuine sales. Some shoddy counterfeits have even killed potential customers.
characters.isa.chapter.thisHappenWhilePa: For this to happen while the patent is still in effect... The higher-ups are very displeased. (frowns slightly)
characters.isa.chapter.iHopeCanHelpUs: I hope you can help us take some of these copies off the market.
characters.isa.chapter.helloIHandsOverLi: Hello. (hands over a list) A recall notice. We're recalling the batches listed here.
characters.isa.chapter.alsoVeBeenAuthori: Also, you've been authorized to resell. Here's this period's allocation.
characters.isa.chapter.thereSActuallyNot: There's actually nothing wrong with this batch. That idiot of a trade manager just priced it too low.
characters.isa.chapter.oxymoreSalesLower: Oxymore sales in the Lower Levels are up forty percent this quarter.
characters.isa.chapter.naloxgoneUpFortyP: Naloxgone is up forty percent too.
characters.isa.chapter.ohSorryLetSGet: Oh, sorry. Let's get back to business.
characters.isa.chapter.iHearHaveSynapres: I hear you have Synaprest? That addiction treatment from pastel.
characters.isa.chapter.rDPeopleInsistTak: The R&D people insist on taking it apart, so they've asked me to buy some.
characters.isa.chapter.weDLikeGetInto: We'd like to get into the addiction treatment business too.
characters.isa.chapter.donTMentionThisAn: Don't mention this to anyone at pastel.
characters.isa.chapter.uhBossSSynaprestI: Uh, boss, it's Synaprest I'm after.
characters.isa.chapter.iHearSpecimenHere: I hear the specimen is here with you? Oh, what a headache. (puts a hand to her forehead)
characters.isa.chapter.evenCompanySBreed: Even the company's breeding program is only through its initial phase. How have you managed to raise it so well?
characters.isa.chapter.setsDownDocumentB: sets down a document and a blood drawer
characters.isa.chapter.allRightIGotBreed: All right, I got you a breeding license. Next time you want to keep an unknown creature like this, please check with me first.
characters.isa.chapter.courseWeLlBuyWhat: Of course, we'll buy whatever the trilobites produce too. Though I don't even know what that is yet.
characters.isa.chapter.haveDrawnItsBlood: Have you drawn its blood yet? R&D needs some raw materials.
characters.isa.chapter.reactorAsLongAsPu: A reactor. As long as the purity is high enough, it can make medicine.
characters.isa.chapter.thisOneSFreeIf: This one's free. If it breaks, though, you'll have to order another at full price.
characters.isa.chapter.hereStaminaBooste: Here, a Stamina Booster. A new product, not on the market yet. We need a few test subjects first.
characters.isa.chapter.permanentlyImprov: It permanently improves your constitution. Every dose needs an application and a lengthy approval process. Make it count, test subject.
characters.isa.chapter.thisOneSThisPerio: This one's for this period. Give me a call when you need more.
characters.isa.chapter.closesFolderRemin: closes the folder, reminds you quietly
characters.isa.chapter.lowerLevelsWillCo: The Lower Levels will come under my jurisdiction next quarter. Do remember to apply regularly, all right? This is good stuff.
characters.isa.daily.rDTookApartLot: R&D took apart a lot of Synaprest. They were trying to make an addiction treatment, but there were too many unknown compounds. All they managed was a painkiller.
characters.isa.daily.rememberApplyStamin: Remember to apply for your Stamina Boosters on time.
characters.isa.daily.channelInspectionJu: Channel inspection. Just a few minutes.
characters.mentor.chapter.broughtSomeHar: Brought you some hardware—the Nestfire and the Liberator. Locally made, all by hand.
characters.mentor.chapter.leavesNoteCoun: leaves a note on the counter
characters.mentor.chapter.mostCargoDocks: Most of the cargo at the docks passes through our hands. Need anything, call this number.
characters.mentor.chapter.iVeHeardPeople: I've heard people recommending your shop lately.
characters.mentor.chapter.thingsHaveBeen: Things have been getting worse lately.
characters.mentor.chapter.rememberBlackM: Remember? The Black Market, the Revolution and the Lower Levels stand as one.
characters.mentor.chapter.ifReDangerCall: If you're in danger, call for help right away. We'll help you.
characters.milo.talk.nutrifruitDoesnTPro: Nutrifruit doesn't produce seeds. That way, once you've eaten it, you have to buy more from us.

settings.init.extraVisitorsArePushedNext: Extra visitors are pushed to the next day: story first, then whoever has waited longest. Paid foot traffic, VIPs and lab buyers don't count.
settings.init.whenEachItemOrderedBy: When on, each item ordered by phone has a weekly limit, tiered by its base value:
settings.init.exclusivesLikeHemingwayLim: Exclusives like Hemingway Limited Edition and the Immunivax case keep their own limits either way.
settings.init.whenVanillaMarketEventsTyp: When on, vanilla market events (a type of item going up or down in price) also change phone order prices: the order price rises or falls by as much as the event moves that type of item, matching how the shop values it.
settings.init.payPriceTimeOrderingNothin:
You pay the price at the time of ordering; nothing is refunded when the event ends. The Spacer grab box and fixed-price machines are not affected.
Off: order prices ignore events (the old behaviour).
settings.init.phoneOrderPriceItemValue:
Phone order price = item value × this (default 1.1). Each higher cooperation tier is 0.05 cheaper: Signed ×1.1, Regular ×1.05, Partner ×1.0 (at the default).
Meridian's high-end attachments and the Leviathan use this multiplier too (regardless of tier). The Spacer grab box is a fixed 500₵. The Hemingway Label Stamp is a fixed 400₵.
settings.init.mostCompanyCharacterWillSp:
The most a company character will spend when buying from you (the six characters and the Solana lab buyer).
Dynamic: 800 + random 0–250 + the current day, based on the richest vanilla customers (750–1000 + day).
How much Solana's VIPs bring depends on “Service strength”.
settings.init.whenCorporatePhoneOrdersNe:
When on: corporate phone orders need a weekly subscription, services cost more, and tier goods must be unlocked by paid application; the Spacer Alliance splits into the Merchant Union and the Resistance; the corporate envoy Zacchaeus comes calling.
Starting a new save is recommended. Turned on mid-game: cooperation tiers are kept, but unlocked goods must be applied for again. Turned off mid-game (from the next day's opening): both sides merge back into the Spacer Alliance, and subscriptions, vouchers, support points and Zacchaeus's accounts are cleared.
settings.init.eachCompanySCooperationTru: On: each company's cooperation (Trust for the Spacer Alliance) rises by at most
settings.init.perDayExcessLost: per day; the excess is lost.
settings.init.tradesOrdersServicesReputa: Trades, orders, services and reputation gains all count; story rewards and story minimums are not capped.
settings.init.tradingWithCompanyPeoplePh:
Trading with company people, phone orders (including the Leviathan), the pastel dealer fee and Meridian refurbishment fees give 1 cooperation point per this many credits (default 400); selling the company's products counts at 3x that (default 1 point per 1200₵).
Vanilla faction reputation rises 1 point per 400₵. Story rewards and the Spacer reputation conversion are not affected.
settings.init.howMuchEnlargeServiceWindo: How much to enlarge the service window opened from company phone calls. 1 = the old size. Shrinks automatically if it doesn't fit the screen.
settings.init.turnWhenWantUninstallToget:
Turn on when you want to uninstall, together with “Confirm cleanup” below. With both on, save once (sleep or save manually):
· company phone numbers are removed from the phone book and the save;
· every item from this mod is deleted (cards, new items, Rosen's guns, the Leviathan, etc.).
Then you can uninstall. Keep it off if you're not uninstalling.
settings.init.onlyTakesEffectTogetherWit: Only takes effect together with “Clean up before uninstalling”. Deleted items cannot be restored.
settings.init.howManyWeeksUntilWeekly: How many weeks until weekly order limits and Davre's Leviathan quota refill. 1 = every week (the original behavior).
settings.init.whichSetCompanyPortraitsUs:

items.definitions.canningMachine.flavor: Commercial canning equipment Davre hands out to small shops in its food war with Pastel.
items.definitions.canningMachine.descrip: Load mince, nutrifruit paste and a battery; it cans overnight, 2 batches per night by default, using 8 charge. Synthetic: 3 nutrifruit paste + 1 scrap mince → 4 cans of Peat. Fresh: 2 prime mince + 1 nutrifruit paste → 1 can of fresh meat. Performance modules run more batches (using more ingredients); efficiency modules save power.
items.definitions.canningMachine.manual:
Load mince and nutrifruit paste in their trays, connect power and select a mode. Grind whole nutrifruit into paste first.
Synthetic: 3 nutrifruit paste + 1 scrap mince → 4 cans of Peat.
Fresh: 2 prime mince + 1 nutrifruit paste → 1 can of fresh meat.
Up to 2 batches per night by default, using 8 charge per run. The output tray must fit the whole batch. Mince for the other mode stays in the tray.
Check Production checks the current setup. Last cycle reports the latest result since loading the save.
Performance modules add batches. Efficiency modules reduce power use.

items.definitions.isomerCarapaceFull.des: Silverblood Trilobite carapace with a pearly sheen. Art piece and luxury item.

items.definitions.davreCannedFish.flavor: Davre printed “WHOLE FISH” on the front. Lift the lid and you can still tell it's a fish.
items.definitions.davreCannedFish.descri: A whole common tilapia, sealed in a can.
items.definitions.fishMince.name: Fish Mince
items.definitions.fishMince.flavor: A small heap of pink mince. Up close, it still smells of fish.
items.definitions.fishMince.description: Ground fish fillets. Four portions make one crab-flavored stick in a sealer.
items.definitions.forgingAnvil.name: Forging Anvil
items.definitions.forgingAnvil.flavor: A power hammer over an anvil, with a quench tank hanging off the side.
items.definitions.forgingAnvil.descripti: Load forged billets and a water container, pick a style and press Forge: 1 billet for a dagger, 2 for a saber, 3 for a machete; 100 ml of water and 6 charge per billet. The cleaner the water, the better the blade.
items.definitions.forgingAnvil.manual:
Load: put forged billets in the billet tray, a water container in the quench tank, and an energy cell in the battery slot.
Forge: pick a style and press Forge. Dagger 1 billet, saber 2, machete 3; 100 ml of water and 6 charge per billet.
Quench: the water grade sets the condition.
Pure → New
Premium → Excellent
Basewater → Good
Ghostwater, Rustwater → Fair
Gutterflow → Poor
Excellent or better counts as a luxury item.
items.definitions.precisionForge.name: Precision Forge
items.definitions.precisionForge.flavor: Rosen's old forge. The fire in it burns all night.
items.definitions.precisionForge.descrip: Load high-purity or better metal ingots and a battery. Each night it turns 1 ingot into 1 forged billet, 2 per night by default, using 15 charge. Performance modules make more (using more ingots); efficiency modules save power.
items.definitions.precisionForge.manual:

Forging: each night 1 ingot becomes 1 forged billet, 2 per night by default, using 15 charge.
[Module effects]:
Efficiency affects power use
Performance affects billets per night (and uses more ingots)
Quality has no effect
items.definitions.forgedBillet.name: Forged Billet
items.definitions.forgedBillet.flavor: Hammer marks still on the surface.
items.definitions.forgedBillet.descripti: A high-purity metal ingot fired overnight in a precision forge. On the anvil: 1 for a dagger, 2 for a saber, 3 for a machete.
items.definitions.freeFrequencyWalkman.f: The interludes from seven albums, spliced together. No tracklist.
items.definitions.freeFrequencyWalkman.d: A walkman with one tape inside. A.L.I.S.O.N. master tape, Eninence cells, Spacer-assembled.
items.definitions.davreFreshMeat.name: Davre Fresh Meat
items.definitions.davreFreshMeat.flavor: Same canning line as Peat, but this one has real meat in it. Davre doesn't sell this kind of "treasure" in the Lower Levels.
items.definitions.davreFreshMeat.descrip: Fresh meat canned with prime mince and nutrifruit paste.
items.definitions.friendOfTheCorporation: A gold “ılı” emblem on a deep purple ribbon. Engraved on the back: Thank you for your contribution to the district's prosperity.
Issued by the Joint District Administration. Put it in the display case: Upper Levels customers carry 10% more money.
items.definitions.nutrifruitPaste.name: Nutrifruit Paste
items.definitions.nutrifruitPaste.flavor: A yellowish lump that smells like overboiled potatoes.
items.definitions.nutrifruitPaste.descri: Made by putting nutrifruit through a meat grinder, by calories: 1 portion per 240 calories, any size of fruit. Canning machines take paste only, not whole nutrifruit.
items.definitions.kottonWorkGloves.name: Kotton Work Gloves
items.definitions.kottonWorkGloves.flavo: Thick Kotton gloves, an engineer's best friend. Take them to the Dumping Grounds at night and your chance of minor injury while scavenging drops by 30%.
items.definitions.hemingwayLabelStamp.fl: The division's stamp for Limited Edition packaging, tape wrapped around the handle. You can't buy one outside.
items.definitions.hemingwayLabelStamp.de: Put it in a packaging machine's label slot. A new stamp has 8 uses. Drag one owned stamp onto another to combine their remaining uses, up to 24. They cannot be combined if the total exceeds 24. Only works in the packaging machine.
items.definitions.implantCompatibilityAg: A thin metal ring around the barrel.
A Carmicheal preparation for implant rejection.
items.definitions.isomerRepairGel.name: Isomer Repair Gel
items.definitions.isomerRepairGel.flavor: Silver-grey and dense, like silver satin.
items.definitions.isomerRepairGel.descri: Gel made from an under-purity batch. Use it to split it into 3 small tubes of isomer solution of varying purity.
items.definitions.isomerReactor.name: Isomer Reactor
items.definitions.isomerReactor.flavor: A sealed lab reactor, silver liquid behind the glass.
items.definitions.isomerReactor.descript: Load a container of activated isomer solution and a battery. Each night it turns it into medicine by purity: 97%+ Rejuvenation Serum, 88%+ Implant Compatibility Agent, 60%+ Isomer Repair Gel. 30 ml of isomer per dose, 1 dose per night by default, using 8 charge.
items.definitions.isomerReactor.manual:
Load a container of activated isomer solution, connect power and wait overnight. Each dose needs 30 mL of isomer in the solution. Up to 1 dose per night by default, using 8 charge per run.
97%+ → Rejuvenation Serum
88%+ → Implant Compatibility Agent
60%+ → Isomer Repair Gel

items.definitions.isomerSolution.name: Isomer Solution
items.definitions.isomerSolution.descrip: A small 10 ml tube. Can also be recovered from isomer repair gel. Purity varies.
items.definitions.leviathanWaterPurifier: Davre modeled it on the HydraTech. It can't handle Gutterflow yet, but it lasts.

items.definitions.looseCigarettes.name: Loose Cigarettes
items.definitions.looseCigarettes.flavor: An unbranded hand-rolled cigarette in yellowed paper.
items.definitions.looseCigarettes.descri: Can be smoked. A packaging machine seals 3 into a pack of Hemingways. Untaxed backroom goods, treated as contraband.
items.definitions.lowerLevelsRepresentat: An old sheet covered in thumbprints and crooked signatures.

items.definitions.eternalNightRepairMask: Put it on, and after your next night out you won't open late or miss customers the next day.
items.definitions.meatGrinder.name: Meat Grinder
items.definitions.meatGrinder.flavor: A commercial grinder issued by Davre. There's still grease on the blades.
items.definitions.meatGrinder.descriptio: Connect power, load raw meat, suitable fish fillets or nutrifruit, and press Grind. Prime mince takes 275 kcal per portion and scrap mince takes 200 kcal, each using 2 charge by default. Fish mince takes 200 kcal and nutrifruit paste takes 240 kcal per portion, each using 1 charge by default.
items.definitions.meatGrinder.manual:
Load raw meat, suitable fish fillets or nutrifruit, connect power, then press Grind. Standard and small cuts make prime mince, and morsels make scrap mince. Prime mince takes 275 kcal per portion and scrap mince 200 kcal, at 2 charge each by default. Suitable fillets yield 1 portion of fish mince per 200 kcal, at 1 charge by default.
Nutrifruit yields 1 paste per 240 kcal, at 1 charge by default. After a partial run, unused calories remain in Paste Reserve. Clear the output or restore power and press Grind again. Less than 240 kcal carries over to the next fruit.
Prions carry over into the product.
items.definitions.meridianAuthorizedDeal: An authorization Meridian Ballistics issued to partner shops. Red on black, stamped with the meridian seal, signed by Rosen, the station manager.
An old certificate Meridian no longer issues. It has no effect. Whether a firearm is legal depends on your weapon permits.
items.definitions.mutualAidMedkit.name: Mutual Aid Medkit
items.definitions.mutualAidMedkit.flavor: No trademark. Just an anchor drawn on the lid.
items.definitions.mutualAidMedkit.descri: A box of everyday medicine. Ashvin's cold-chain gel, copied by Spacers, handed out by the Front.
items.definitions.oilflowerBlossoms.name: Oilflower Blossoms
items.definitions.oilflowerBlossoms.desc: Blend, then extract with warm alcohol. Each 10 mL of oil becomes 1 material, with no purity requirement. Aromatic Compounds I yields up to 10 mL per flower; higher ranks produce more mash. Cannot be planted.
items.definitions.oilflowerSeeds.name: Oilflower Seeds
items.definitions.oilflowerSeeds.descrip: About 6 nights for 4 flowers. Innate Aromatic Compounds I and Infertile III reduce, but do not eliminate, seed returns. Remove infertility to insert Perennial. Refruit base work: 21, with native gene yield and speed modifiers. Gold members may buy 2 per rolling 7 days.
items.definitions.packagingMachine.name: Packaging Machine
items.definitions.packagingMachine.flavo: Proper pastel packaging equipment. Run your smokes through it and they're Hemingways.
items.definitions.packagingMachine.descr: Load loose cigarettes and a battery. Each night it seals 3 cigarettes into 1 genuine Hemingway pack, 2 packs by default, using 8 charge. Performance modules seal more (using more cigarettes); efficiency modules save power. With a label stamp in the label slot, packs come out as Limited Edition.
items.definitions.packagingMachine.manua:
Load loose cigarettes, connect power and wait overnight. Every 3 loose cigarettes make 1 pack of Hemingways. It makes up to 2 packs per night by default, using 8 charge per run.
A Hemingway stamp in the label slot makes Limited Edition packs and uses 1 stamp charge per pack.

items.definitions.silverBloodRefiningHan:
Step 1: Sterilize
- Pour the silver blood into a chemistry container and put it on a heating plate
- Heat to 70-85C to kill the microbes
WARNING: raw isomer denatures above 85C

Step 2: Activate
- Cool to 60-75C
- Add Reducing Agent equal to half the raw isomer
- Hold the temperature until it has all converted
WARNING: 75-85C converts faster but loses some of it

Step 3: Clean up
- Same as regular chemicals

Step 4: Evaporate
- Use the Evaporator
- (REQUIRED) All water, alcohol and Lipobond Agent are evaporated

Step 5: React
- Load it into the Isomer Reactor
- 97%+ purity makes Rejuvenation Serum, 88%+ Implant Compatibility Agent, 60%+ Isomer Repair Gel
Carmicheal internal procedure: every step from silver blood to the reactor.
